text:
alex chen: heads up — customer reported a spike of 500s from hosted inference API (model predict). started ~10:22 UTC, ~30% of requests 500 for a short window. sample req id: rq_0a1b2c3d. stack traces show quota/ratelimit path returning 500 instead of 429.

mira patel: can you paste an example curl and a log snippet? which route /model or /chat?

alex chen: /v1/models/redwood-large:predict (text-generation). curl: ```\ncurl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/models/redwood-large:predict \n```
log snippet: ``[2026-07-15T10:22:11Z] rq_0a1b2c3d INFO proxy -> sidecar: calling quota-check
[2026-07-15T10:22:11Z] rq_0a1b2c3d ERROR quota-sidecar: timeout awaiting response from ratekeeper (timeout=200ms) -> fallback handler returns 500
[2026-07-15T10:22:11Z] rq_0a1b2c3d WARN proxy: fallback to 500 due to quota-sidecar failure
```

ben park: interesting — timeout=200ms small. sidecar should return 429 on rate limit, not 500. looks like sidecar timeout path returns 500. checking metrics now (pool saturation?).

ops-bot: Automated alert: quota-sidecar error-rate (5xx) > baseline (x15) between 10:22-10:26 UTC. Top symptoms: connection pool timeouts, increased p95 latency to 350ms.

mira patel: @ben any traces for connection pool exhaustion? the service graph will show if quota-sidecar downstream DB/redis was healthy.

ben park: found a cluster of logs from the sidecar: ``connection_pool: exhausted, waiting for free connection``. Also a spike of ephemeral client reconnects. Looks like burst backpressure -> client queueing -> sidecar request-handling timeout -> proxy fallback returns 500.

samira liu: tl;dr: misroute of failure type. If sidecar times out, proxy currently treats it as 500. We should map sidecar timeouts to 429 for quota-related failures so user sees rate limit instead of internal error. quick mitigation: bump sidecar request timeout to 1s and increase pool max to 50. longer term: make timeout->429 mapping.

oncall-jane: oncall here — can we do a fast mitigation now (config change) or need code rollback?

ben park: config-only. sidecar exposes runtime flags via config service. I can push a temporary increase to pool + timeout and toggle the fallback mapping to 429 for timeouts. will push to canary first (us-east-1).

alex chen: customer impact: several enterprise customers saw 500s and opened tickets. sent updates to CSP. they want ETA.

mira patel: repro steps for eng: 1) set a low quota on client to force enforcement; 2) run 200 concurrent requests with short interval; 3) observe sidecar pool exhaustion and 500s. sample load test: ```bash
seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P50 -I{} curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer x\" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/models/redwood-large:predict >/dev/null
```

ben park: rolling canary patch now:
1) config bump: quota-sidecar.timeout_ms=1000 (was 200)
2) quota-sidecar.pool_max=50 (was 20)
3) proxy: treat quota-sidecar timeout as RATE_LIMIT (map -> 429)

ops-bot: deploy started: canary quota-sidecar config in us-east-1 on 2 hosts.

oncall-jane: monitoring — watching 5xx rate and 429s. notify if >5xx baseline or 429 spike.

(5m passes)

ops-bot: canary metrics: 5xx rate down 90% on patched hosts, 429 count increased as expected on canary. overall cluster 5xx back to baseline after 4 minutes.

alex chen: confirmed with customer — errors resolved for now. they asked for root cause and permanent fix.

mira patel: immediate RCA hypothesis: quota-sidecar connection pool + aggressive timeouts combined with traffic bursts from some customers. timeout path was implemented to surface internal error (500) and not map timeout->429, causing misleading 5xx. misroute in failure semantics.

samira liu: next steps (short): 1) push config changes cluster-wide and increase pool/timeouts 2) change proxy mapping logic so any timeout to quota-sidecar returns 429 with metrics label quota_timeout=true 3) add circuit-breaker when downstream latency spikes to shed load with 429s 4) add replayable test in chaos suite to ensure 5xx->429 mapping preserved.

ben park: created ticket INF-4321 for permanent fix (code + tests). will include config knobs and mapping change. scheduling a PR today.

alex chen: notes for postmortem: customer impact, timeline, mitigations, code fix ticket, config audit for other sidecars. assign owners: ben (fix + PR), samira (proxy mapping), mira (RCA doc + customer comms).

oncall-jane: tagging oncall rotation and runbook update. add a CRITICAL check: if quota-sidecar 5xx > 0.5% and 429 not present -> alert to SRE.

mira patel: thanks all. will draft the incident summary and ping legal/customer-ops once RCA done. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident CLOSED (metric recovery observed). Followups assigned: INF-4321, DOC-789 (runbook update).
